record.title: DfCM reachable frontier
record.body: Reachable frontier after R57 manufacture: exact candidate c5a973bf14e582c005bd4ce0cc39828c194f4249 adds a reusable 50-court adapter-capital selector/diagnostic family over the grounded four-consumer graph and repairs two inherited anti-compositional R56 verifier assumptions. Newly explicit edges: ex4pm target-local adapter -> exact consumer qualification -> independent receipt return; GymAct target-local adapter -> exact consumer qualification -> independent receipt return; cloud standing/receipt closure; current-default reconstitution of preserved R54 independence measurement; pair/triple composition only after independent receipts; causal downstream yield measurement. Full structural adapter readiness stays 2/10, shortfall 8; 1000X remains NOT_ADMITTED. Broad CI is still in progress, so PR #274 remains unmerged at this record.
